data.prompt: Составь отчёт по открытым задачам учебного трекера. Сохрани его в open-tasks.md в виде Markdown-таблицы с колонками ID и Название. Упорядочь строки по ID.

skills.name: open-task-report
skills.description: Use for a report or summary of open tasks from the educational tracker, especially when the user wants a Markdown file based on live tracker records.

skills.name: presentation-design
skills.description: Use when asked to outline a slide deck, such as planning slide titles, a visual hierarchy, and a presentation narrative for a stated audience.

skills.name: progress-summary
skills.description: Use for aggregating lesson completion and duration from a local educational progress dataset into a per-learner summary.
